needs the Lorenz curve defined over two pages. LEAD FOR A LATER PASS: a real Terminale exercise can be built by folding the definition into the statement. Gini index G = 2 * integral of (x - L(x)) on [0,1]. For L(x) = x^2, G = 1/3; for L(x) = x^k, G = (k-1)/(k+1). Both checked by hand.

notes: Pass 1, 2026-09-19, 22 exercises (2801-2822 of the 2801-3000 block, contiguous, none left unused). Sources used: session 6 Relays (Handout-1301-1322 + answer key Handout-1302), session 27 Limits of Sequences, session 66 Combinatorics II, session 134 Counting and probabilities, session 139 Proofs using Induction, session 152 Inequalities. All 27 Relays answers were re-verified by brute force in Python and every one matched the official key, so the ten imported from it are double-checked. The other twelve were solved from scratch and checked (brute force where possible). Sessions 0 to 10 of the list have all been opened and judged; next_session is set to 11 but sessions 0-10 need no revisit. TWO DUPLICATES FOR THE COORDINATOR: 2811 duplicates 2002 in the same folder (grade-12/algebra/3, sum of cubes), and 2806 is the same problem as 1604 (units digit of k^2 + 2^k, 2008 instead of 2020) at a different grade, cross linked with see_also. Both were kept per the no-delete rule. WHAT IS LEFT IN THIS UNIT: the remaining 147 sessions are dominated by university topics (tropical geometry, quandles, homotopy, quadratic reciprocity, Gaussian integers, special relativity, queueing theory, stable marriage). The rich veins for a later pass are the AMC problem sessions (index 133 Handout-880-935, index 149: Handout-818-914 is an AMC 12 multiple-choice practice set and Handout-819-914 a relay-style problem list; neither carries an answer key, so both must be solved and verified), index 97 Problems from Moscow Math Olympiads, index 58 Probability and Bayes Rule, index 63 and 114 and 117 and 120 Game Theory, index 62 Geometry, index 31 and 156 Mass Point Geometry, index 144 Algebra and combinatorics, index 152 Inequalities (5 problems left), index 139 and 143 Induction (drills left), and index 84/109/13/4 The Gini Index if someone folds the Lorenz curve into a statement.
